verdict_definition: The artifact may or may not be acceptable. The evaluation that ran was inadequate to make a defensible determination, so no determination is claimed.
rationale: The artifact defines no acceptance criteria.
Running checks without criteria shows activity, not conformance.

checks.summary: 1 interpolations are escaped inadequately for their context
checks.limitation: static reading of HTML construction sites and the artifact's own escape function; it shows that an escaper's character set is insufficient for a context, not that a particular input reaches that context at runtime

findings.title: `set_html` builds markup from an interpolated value in frontend/app.howl
findings.summary: A call to `set_html` assembles HTML containing an interpolated value and no escape function appears in the surrounding expression.
findings.recommended_remediation: Route every interpolated value through the artifact's escape function, or set text content instead of markup.

reproduction.summary: Re-read the source and match the same construction.
